scope: Solve the observed training-side classification gap first; no automatic promotion.
supersedes_direction: V129 R/D/X transfer trial deferred, evidence retained.

input.ordered_body_reserved: No new body-only branch in this qualification trial.

labels.M_S_training: All legal ASA outer TRAIN rows, unchanged official labels.
labels.mixed_inputs: Retain in full fit/evaluation; separately report empirical collision error floor.

model.base: Custom SparseTabM adapter, not an exact reproduction of the paper.

initialization.small_to_wide: Copy common 128 blocks, factors and facts head; random new channels; zero new-to-common second-layer weights and extra head columns. Initial logits must match within 1e-6; do not initialize every extra weight to zero.
initialization.delayed_new_channel_gradient: Expected at update zero; inspect again after updates 1, 10 and 100.

loss.pure_class_CE: 0.5 * sum_c in {M,S} [sum_i in single-label canonical TRAIN inputs n_ic mean_member CE(z_i,c) / N_pure_c]
loss.accounting: Full-epoch original row/class mass conservation. Denominators fixed to whole legal fit population; unbiased batch scaling by number of logical batches. No per-batch class renormalization.
loss.member_training: Mean of individual member losses, never CE of averaged predictions.
loss.inference: Argmax of mean member probabilities; no threshold tuning.
loss.mixed_safeguard: Mixed inputs appear in row_CE with unchanged relative original label masses, and receive no pure-class auxiliary loss. Do not add class weights to mixed labels.
loss.weighting_claim: The auxiliary pure-class risk is a bounded diagnostic factor, not established debiasing or a deployable solution.
loss.rejected_blind_class_balance: Fold1 one numerical input has 72M/6S. Unrestricted full class-normalized CE favors S and 72 M errors; this contradicts the zero-M-error TRAIN gate. Retain as an executable counterexample.

tiny_probe.population: 64 distinct single-label canonical TRAIN inputs: 32 M, 32 hard S, all six paired-body keys represented.
tiny_probe.batch: Same full 64-input batch every update, original selected row masses retained.
tiny_probe.failure_action: If both fail, stop full trials and inspect exact dense-vs-sparse forward/gradient, target alignment, input resolution and activation/update paths. Failure does not prove labels or task are impossible.
tiny_probe.acceptance_boundary: Memorization/pipeline qualification only; discard probe model, reset before full fitting.

primary_trial.schedule: Constant, identical to the old direct-model learning rule; fixed longer budget isolated by R25/R100 trajectory. No new LR schedule in this factorial.
primary_trial.explanation: 100 epochs is a predeclared diagnostic budget, not proven sufficiency. Earlier results show trajectories; they cannot replace the registered endpoint.

learning_gate.meaning: At least 95% of the 527 observed pure-input S mistakes repaired while every legal TRAIN M remains correct. The 6-row empirical collision floor is retained in scoring, not relabeled.
learning_gate.claim: A new project target, not an achieved result or a guarantee from research.

selection.authority: TRAIN qualification only, before reading any newly generated held results.
selection.rule: First eligible arm at epoch100; no held-driven choice among arms/epochs/seeds.
selection.none_pass: Stop: training-side classification remains unsolved. Do not run a transfer confirmation.
selection.loss_only_improves: Record probability learning but mark classification learning failed.
selection.safety: New held-output files are sealed and remain unread until the TRAIN-only choice is recorded.

record.gradient_diagnosis: At epochs0/25/50/100 compute whole-fit M and S parameter gradients, original-weight and pure-class-normalized module norms/cosines, without optimizer updates. Negative cosine is a local observation, not proof that gradient surgery will help.
record.all_errors: Repaired, persistent, newly wrong and mixed-input rows remain in distinct ledgers.

confirmation.on_learning_pass: Run predeclared same selected configuration in folds0/2 with matched R100 controls if selected arm differs from R. Do not alter method by fold.
confirmation.quality_eligibility: Must pass preserved full original-row/per-class/source protections before later independent seed or official blind confirmation.
confirmation.learning_vs_transfer: Improved TRAIN classification with poor held classification solves only learning fit, not support coverage or stable transfer.

historical_constraints: V116: never qualify an early checkpoint instead of the registered endpoint.
V118/V121: no automatic reuse of class-mass batch rearrangement; it worsened real classification.
V104/V113/V128: an S gain bought with M damage is not acceptance.
V124-V128: no-correct-member, full actual-input conflicts and body conflicts must be separate.
V129: facts-only projection loses discriminative information; no deletion of legal full input.
V62 and later weighting controls: balancing may just move the boundary; require simultaneous M/S classification gates.

required_before_updates: V130-specific checker and historical counterexample replay
seal_run/check_bindings of actual entry, all imported sources, views, independent labels, splits and panels
audit late checkpoint identities and cumulative original class mass
